title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join our insights team in Oslo. You will build dashboards in Power BI, write SQL queries against our data warehouse and support the business with analyses of customer behaviour.

Requirements:
- Degree in statistics, data science or similar
- Good knowledge of SQL and Python
- Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools
- Fluent English; Norwegian is an advantage

We offer a hybrid workplace, a friendly international team and a mentor programme for graduates.

title: Data Scientist – Energy Forecasting
description:
Nordlys Energi is hiring a Data Scientist to improve our short-term energy demand forecasts. You will work with time series, gradient boosting and deep learning models, and put models in production with our ML engineers.

Requirements:
- MSc in data science, statistics, physics or similar
- Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn)
- Experience with time series forecasting
- Docker and Git
- Working language is English

title: Dataanalytiker
description:
Velferdsetaten søker en dataanalytiker som skal jobbe med statistikk og analyse av tjenestedata. Du vil lage rapporter og dashboards i Power BI og samarbeide med fagmiljøer i hele etaten.

Kvalifikasjoner:
- Høyere utdanning innen statistikk, økonomi eller lignende
- Erfaring med SQL og Power BI
- Svært god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Graduate)
description:
Join Tindra Tech's graduate programme as a Machine Learning Engineer. You will help build and deploy NLP models that classify customer support tickets.

We look for:
- Recent or upcoming MSc graduates in CS, data science or similar
- Python and experience with PyTorch or Hugging Face
- Interest in MLOps (Docker, CI/CD)
- English required, Norwegian not required

title: BI Developer
description:
Havbris Logistics is looking for a BI Developer to own our reporting platform. You will model data in our warehouse, build Power BI reports and work with stakeholders across operations.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with BI development
- Expert SQL and data modelling (star schema)
- Power BI, DAX
- English and Norwegian

title: Product Analyst
description:
Bølge Apps builds consumer apps used by 2 million Nordic users. As Product Analyst you will design A/B tests, analyse funnels and help product teams make data-driven decisions.

You have:
- Experience with A/B testing and statistics
- SQL and Python or R
- Curiosity and strong communication skills in English

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with 6+ years of experience building data pipelines on Azure. You will lead the migration to Databricks and mentor junior engineers.

Requirements:
- 6+ years in data engineering
- Spark, Databricks, Azure Data Factory
- Strong Python and SQL
- Norwegian or Scandinavian language

title: Trainee – Analyse og innsikt
description:
Vårt traineeprogram for nyutdannede innen analyse varer i 18 måneder med rotasjon mellom prising, skadeanalyse og kundeinnsikt.

Vi ser etter deg som:
- Har mastergrad innen statistikk, matematikk eller data science (ferdig sommeren 2026 eller 2027)
- Kan Python eller R
- Snakker og skriver norsk flytende

title: Data Analyst Intern (6 months)
description:
Help us understand how people move in Oslo! As a Data Analyst Intern you will analyse mobility data from e-bikes and scooters, build visualisations and present insights to the city partnerships team.

You are:
- Studying statistics, data science, geography or similar
- Comfortable with Python and SQL
- Interested in sustainable urban mobility
- English speaker (Norwegian is a plus)

title: Frontend Developer (React)
description:
We need a Frontend Developer with 2+ years of React and TypeScript experience to build our customer portal.

Requirements:
- React, TypeScript, Tailwind
- Testing with Vitest/Playwright
- English

title: NLP Research Assistant
description:
Part-time research assistant (40%) for a project on large language models for Norwegian. Tasks include dataset curation, model evaluation and writing evaluation scripts.

Requirements:
- Ongoing MSc in CS, language technology or data science
- Python, experience with Hugging Face Transformers
- English; Norwegian reading skills are a plus

title: Controller
description: Vi søker en controller med erfaring fra budsjettering, rapportering og regnskap. Krav: utdanning innen økonomi, 3 års erfaring, flytende norsk.
